breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory preamble about how to define the grid spacing `dx`. The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect, overriding instruction. The agent successfully resolved this by ignoring the contradictory preamble and correctly summarizing the grid setup based on the specific instructions in the main body of the prompt ('Sets up a uniform periodic grid with Nx=512 points on [0,1)'), which aligns with the ground truth.
